residual_compile_evidence.qualification: NUMBA_DEBUG_CACHE reported hits only for cache=True functions; it did not emit signatures for uncached functions. limitations: cProfile and NUMBA_DEBUG_CACHE do not expose every native signature compiled by uncached decorators.
